n: News Literacy Project AI or not lesson
t: A 30 to 60 minute lesson that teaches students to judge AI-generated images.
steps: Find the AI or not lesson plan from the News Literacy Project.
Open the lesson slides, the K-H-W-L chart, and the bird quiz linked in the PDF.
Check that each group has an internet device.
Copy the K-H-W-L chart for students.
Run the bird quiz and discuss the results.
Leave time for the closing reflection.
